description: Find independent stays bookable direct on Bookd (hotels, B&Bs, guesthouses, apartments, houses, villas, cabins) for a location and dates. Read-only: nothing is booked or held. Bookd properties come first: only properties with a room or unit free for every night are returned, cheapest first (exact town matches first), paginated. Each result has nightly price, total_price (incl. any cleaning fee and taxes), cancellation policy, bedrooms/bathrooms/beds for whole homes, any information-only damage deposit held by the property, and any deposit due (only when the property takes card deposits; otherwise the guest pays the property directly). If no Bookd property matches a location, the result has partner_results instead: links to partner hotels (accommodation only) on Trip.com and a Stay22 map for that place, dates and guests, with min_price, max_price, stars and currency applied. Partner hotels are not Bookd properties: the guest books and pays on Trip.com or the partner site, under that site's terms, and Bookd may earn a commission. Never call request_booking for them. Finding the partner city sends only the location text to Trip.com.

currency.description: Currency for partner hotel links and their price filter. Default: local currency of the place (EUR in the euro area, GBP in the UK, INR in India, else USD).

location.description: Town, county/state or country, e.g. "Doolin", "County Clare", "Ireland", "UK", "North Carolina", "United States". Empty = everywhere.

max_price.description: Max price per room or unit per night. Bookd properties: in the property currency. Partner hotel links: in currency.

min_price.description: Min price per room or unit per night. Bookd properties: in the property currency. Partner hotel links: in currency.

property_type.description: Filter by type: hotel, bnb, guesthouse, inn, hostel, motel, lodge, apartment, condo, house, villa, cabin, cottage, chalet, other ("B&B" and "vacation rental" are understood)

stars.description: Minimum star rating (3, 4 or 5) for partner hotel links. Bookd properties have no star rating and are never hidden by it.

whole_home.description: true = only whole homes (apartment, condo, house, villa, cabin, cottage, chalet)

name: search_stays
title: Search stays on Bookd
